name: Percy Jackson

appearance.height: average for age, growing taller across series
notable_features: Curse of Achilles mark on small of back in Book 5

special_states: Bore the Curse of Achilles (Achilles Mark on small of back) during Book 5
Transformed into a guinea pig by Circe in Book 2 (restored by Hermes multivitamins)
quote: Look, I didn't want to be a half-blood.
description: Son of Poseidon, hero of Olympus, slayer of monsters across the PJO novels, Demigod Files, and Singer of Apollo.
lore_notes: Claimed by Poseidon at age twelve during capture-the-flag. Bathed in the River Styx in Book 5 to gain invulnerability.

name: Annabeth Chase

notable_features: intense gray eyes like storm clouds
Camp Half-Blood bead necklace with ring

special_states: Forced to hold up the sky in Book 3 (gained a streak of gray hair alongside Percy)
Appointed Official Architect of Olympus at the end of Book 5
quote: You never can tell what's going to happen. But whatever it is, I want to be part of it.
description: Daughter of Athena and Frederick Chase. Primary strategist of Camp Half-Blood, quest leader in the Labyrinth, and Percy's core partner.
lore_notes: Born as a mind-child from Athena's divine intellect and Frederick's mind.

name: Grover Underwood

appearance.hair_description: curly brown hair hiding small goat horns

special_states: Received the spirit blessing of Pan upon Pan's fading in Book 4
Appointed to the Council of Cloven Elders and named Lord of the Wild in Book 5
quote: I'm a satyr! We don't have souls!
description: Satyr protector assigned to bring demigods safely to Camp Half-Blood. Best friend to Percy Jackson, with whom he shares a telepathic Empathy Link.
lore_notes: Age 28 in Book 1, which equals 14 in human developmental terms for satyrs.

name: Luke Castellan
fatal_flaw: Resentment toward the gods / Bitter anger over neglected demigods

notable_features: jagged white scar from eye to jaw received from a dragon

special_states: Possessed as mortal vessel for Kronos in Book 4 and Book 5
Bathed in River Styx (Achilles mark under left armpit)
Sacrificed himself to destroy Kronos at the end of Book 5
quote: We need a new age, Percy. Not a repainting of the old one.
description: Son of Hermes and May Castellan. Former Hermes cabin head counselor who betrayed Camp Half-Blood to serve Kronos due to resentment of divine neglect.
lore_notes: Gave Annabeth her Celestial Bronze dagger when she was seven.

name: Thalia Grace
fatal_flaw: Ambition and desire for power / Fear of failure

notable_features: punk clothing and silver tiara of Hunter Lieutenant

special_states: Transformed into a pine tree by Zeus upon dying at Camp boundary before Book 1
Resurrected from pine tree by Golden Fleece at end of Book 2
Pledged eternal maidenhood and became Lieutenant of Artemis at end of Book 3
quote: I am Thalia, daughter of Zeus.
description: Daughter of Zeus. Sacrificed herself at Half-Blood Hill and was turned into a protective pine tree. Freed by the Golden Fleece, she joined the Hunters of Artemis.
lore_notes: Sufferer of extreme acrophobia (fear of heights) despite being Zeus's daughter.

name: Nico di Angelo
special_states: Kept in the Lotus Hotel & Casino for decades with Bianca prior to Book 3
Proclaimed himself Ghost King after defeating King Minos's spirit in Book 4
quote: With true power comes true solitude.
description: Son of Hades and Maria di Angelo. Born in 1930s Italy and hidden in the Lotus Casino. Masters necromancy and leads Underworld troops in Manhattan.
lore_notes: Child of Hades born before the Big Three Oath.

name: Bianca di Angelo
fatal_flaw: Desire for independence / Leaving her brother behind
special_states: Joined Hunters of Artemis in Book 3
Died in Junkyard of the Gods destroying defective Talos automaton
quote: I want my own life, Nico.
description: Daughter of Hades and elder sister of Nico. Rescued from Westover Hall, joined the Hunters of Artemis, and died heroically in the Junkyard of the Gods.
lore_notes: Appears as a ghost to Nico in Book 4 urging him to forgive Percy.

name: Tyson

notable_features: single large eye in middle of forehead

special_states: Named General of the Cyclopes Army by Poseidon at end of Book 5
quote: Ponies! Rainbow ponies!
description: Young Cyclops son of Poseidon and half-brother of Percy. Skilled weapon-smith who forged Percy's shield and led Cyclopes forces against Typhon.
lore_notes: is_demigod = false because Cyclopes are monstrous species/offspring rather than human demigods.

name: Chiron

appearance.hair_description: thinning brown hair and bushy beard
appearance.build: upper body human, lower body white stallion
appearance.height: over seven feet tall in centaur form
notable_features: wheelchair disguise when compacted into human form

special_states: Uses magical wheelchair to compress lower horse body into human form for mortal disguise
quote: Thou shalt not kill, Percy. But monsters are another matter.
description: Immortal centaur activities director at Camp Half-Blood and trainer of legendary heroes (Perseus, Hercules, Achilles).
lore_notes: Son of Kronos and Philyra in classical myth.

name: Clarisse La Rue
special_states: Blessed with Ares's combat frenzy during the slaying of the Lydian Drakon in Book 5
quote: We're going to pulverize you!
description: Daughter of Ares and head counselor of Cabin 5. Leads the official quest for the Golden Fleece and single-handedly slays the Lydian Drakon.
lore_notes: Wields the electric spear Maimer.

name: Charles Beckendorf
special_states: Died in Greek fire explosion demolishing the Princess Andromeda in opening of Book 5
quote: See ya, Percy.
description: Son of Hephaestus and head counselor of Cabin 9. Master blacksmith and boyfriend of Silena Beauregard.
lore_notes: Chosen for Elysium in Underworld judgment.

name: Silena Beauregard
fatal_flaw: Unwavering romantic love / Vulnerability to blackmail
special_states: Blackmailed by Luke into acting as Kronos's camp spy
Disguised herself in Clarisse's Ares armor to lead Cabin 5 into battle, dying heroically against the Drakon
quote: I was the spy. I'm sorry.
description: Daughter of Aphrodite and head counselor of Cabin 10. Girlfriend of Beckendorf. Redeemed herself by leading the charge against the Lydian Drakon.
lore_notes: Honored as a hero of Camp Half-Blood upon her death.

name: Ethan Nakamura
fatal_flaw: Desire for balance and recognition for minor gods

notable_features: black eyepatch over left eye given to Nemesis in exchange for power

special_states: Pledged his oath to Kronos in Book 4 to awaken the Titan Lord
Turned on Kronos in throne room in Book 5 and was killed falling from Olympus
quote: All the minor gods... deserve respect!
description: Son of Nemesis who lost an eye to pledge his allegiance to Kronos. In the final battle on Olympus, he turned on Kronos.
lore_notes: His final plea inspired Percy's demand that the gods claim all children and build minor god cabins.

name: Zoë Nightshade
fatal_flaw: Misplaced trust / Resentment toward male demigods
special_states: Transformed into the star constellation 'The Huntress' by Artemis upon her death in Book 3
quote: Stars. I can see the stars again, my lady.
description: Exiled Hesperid nymph and daughter of Atlas. Gave Hercules his sword Riptide in ancient times. Died in battle against Atlas on Mount Tamalpais.
lore_notes: Transformed into a star constellation upon death.

name: Sally Jackson

appearance.hair_description: long brown hair with gray streaks appearing over time
notable_features: scent of blue candy and cookies

special_states: Petrified Gabe Ugliano using Medusa's severed head in Book 1
quote: Blue food is my favorite.
description: Mortal mother of Percy Jackson who possesses Clear Sight. Marries Paul Blofis and writes novels.
lore_notes: can_see_through_mist = true.

name: Rachel Elizabeth Dare

notable_features: glowing green eyes when speaking prophecy

special_states: Hit Kronos in the eye with a plastic hairbrush at the Battle of the Labyrinth
Host vessel for the Spirit of the Oracle of Delphi at end of Book 5
quote: I throw plastic hairbrushes at Titan Lords.
description: Mortal girl with extraordinary ability to see through the Mist. Accepts the Spirit of Delphi into her body, becoming the new living Oracle.
lore_notes: character_type = oracle, is_oracle = true.

name: Daedalus
fatal_flaw: Obsession with invention / Fear of death

notable_features: glowing bronze animus joint at neck

special_states: Transferred his soul into five successive automaton bodies across millennia
Disguised as sword master Quintus at Camp Half-Blood in Book 4
Died voluntarily at end of Book 4 to collapse the Labyrinth
quote: My Labyrinth is linked to my life force. When I die, the maze will die with me.
description: Ancient Greek inventor and son of Athena who built the Labyrinth. Cheated death by transferring his soul into automaton bodies.
lore_notes: Gifted his 3D laptop of designs to Annabeth Chase.

name: Calypso
special_states: Bound to the phantom island of Ogygia by gods as punishment for supporting Atlas
Cursed to fall in love with heroes who can never stay
quote: The gods curse me with heroes who cannot stay.
description: Immortal daughter of Atlas imprisoned on the island of Ogygia. Nurse and host to Percy Jackson in Book 4.
lore_notes: Percy refused her offer of immortality on Ogygia.

name: Oracle of Delphi

appearance.hair_description: withered black hair on mummy body
notable_features: desiccated mummy body sitting in Big House attic
green prophetic mist pouring from mouth

special_states: Cursed by Hades after WWII to remain trapped in her dead mortal body until the Great Prophecy was fulfilled
Transferred into Rachel Elizabeth Dare at end of Book 5
quote: I am the spirit of Delphi, speaker of the prophecies of Phoebus Apollo.
description: Prophetic spirit of Apollo housed in the desiccated attic mummy at Camp Half-Blood.
lore_notes: Cursed by Hades when he destroyed the Washington D.C. hotel.

name: Chris Rodriguez
special_states: Driven insane wandering Daedalus's Labyrinth for Kronos in Book 4
Healed of madness by Dionysus at Camp Half-Blood
quote: The maze... it twists your mind.
description: Son of Hermes who initially joined Luke's rebellion. Driven mad while scouting the Labyrinth, he was healed by Dionysus.
lore_notes: Restored to sanity by Dionysus in Book 4.

name: Perseus
quote: I brought you a gift, King Polydectes.
description: Ancient demigod son of Zeus who slew Medusa using a polished bronze shield, winged sandals, and a kibisis sack.
lore_notes: Percy Jackson was named after him because Perseus was one of the few heroes to get a happy ending.

name: Theseus

notable_features: sword and sandals retrieved from beneath rock

quote: I go to Crete to slay the beast.
description: Ancient hero son of Poseidon who navigated Daedalus's Labyrinth using Ariadne's string and killed the Cretan Minotaur.
lore_notes: Forgot to change his ship's black sails to white, causing King Aegeus to jump to his death.

name: Heracles

appearance.hair_description: thick curly dark hair and beard

special_states: Elevated to full Olympian godhood upon his mortal death on a pyre
quote: Bring me another labor!
description: Greatest ancient Greek demigod who performed Twelve Labors, wore the Nemean Lion pelt, and was elevated to godhood.
lore_notes: Zoë Nightshade gave him Riptide, but Heracles took all the credit without mentioning her.

name: Celedon
special_states: Enchanted with hypnotic vocal music that compels listeners to applaud endlessly
quote: (Sings hypnotically in Times Square)
description: Golden automaton singer forged by Hephaestus for Apollo. Escapes to NYC before being captured by Percy.
lore_notes: One of four golden singers (chryseae) created for Apollo's choir.

name: Travis Stoll
quote: We're Hermes campers. We always have a plan.
description: Demigod son of Hermes and older brother of Connor Stoll. Co-head counselor of Cabin 11 at Camp Half-Blood.
lore_notes: Frequently confused with his brother Connor, though Travis is older.

name: Connor Stoll
quote: We didn't steal it! We just borrowed it indefinitely.
description: Demigod son of Hermes and younger brother of Travis Stoll. Co-head counselor of Cabin 11 who fights in the Battle of Manhattan.
lore_notes: One year younger than Travis.

name: May Castellan

notable_features: glowing green eyes when possessed by Oracle spirit

special_states: Cursed by Hades/Oracle Spirit failure
quote: I'm making sandwiches for Luke! He'll be home soon.
description: Mortal mother of Luke Castellan. Possesses Clear Sight. Attempted to host the Spirit of Delphi despite Hades's curse, leaving her mind shattered.
lore_notes: Her tragic state drove Luke to resent Hermes and the gods.

name: Frederick Chase

notable_features: wears tweed jacket and aviator cap

quote: I have Celestial Bronze bullets!
description: Mortal father of Annabeth Chase and professor of military history in San Francisco. Assists the demigods at Mount Tamalpais.
lore_notes: Reconciles with Annabeth in The Titan's Curse.

name: Malcolm Pace
quote: Cabin Six, hold the line!
description: Demigod son of Athena and second-in-command of Cabin 6 under Annabeth Chase.
lore_notes: First seen walking in on Percy and Annabeth hugging in Cabin 6 in Book 4.

name: Jake Mason
quote: Beckendorf would have wanted us to fight.
description: Human demigod son of Hephaestus who steps up as head counselor of Cabin 9 after Charles Beckendorf's death.
lore_notes: Leads Cabin 9 forge work during the Battle of Manhattan.

name: Will Solace
quote: I need ambrosia and nectar, stat!
description: Demigod son of Apollo and skilled medic who heals wounded demigods during the Battle of Manhattan.
lore_notes: Takes over as Cabin 7 head counselor after Michael Yew's disappearance.

name: Michael Yew
special_states: Presumed dead after collapsing the Williamsburg Bridge in Book 5
quote: Percy, drop the bridge!
description: Son of Apollo and head counselor of Cabin 7 after Lee Fletcher's death. Commands archers at Williamsburg Bridge.
lore_notes: Vanished into the East River when the bridge collapsed.

name: Lee Fletcher
special_states: Killed during the Battle of the Labyrinth
quote: Apollo cabin, ready bows!
description: Demigod son of Apollo and head counselor of Cabin 7 who fought and died in the Battle of the Labyrinth.
lore_notes: Succeeded by Michael Yew.

name: Castor
special_states: Killed by enemy demigods in the Battle of the Labyrinth
quote: Fight for camp!
description: Demigod son of Dionysus and twin brother of Pollux. Slain during the Battle of the Labyrinth.
lore_notes: His death caused Dionysus deep grief and prompted Dionysus to cure Chris Rodriguez.

name: Pollux
quote: I'll fight in Castor's memory.
description: Demigod son of Dionysus and twin brother of Castor. Survives the Battle of Manhattan after losing his twin.
lore_notes: Ordered by Dionysus to stay safe during the final battle.

name: Katie Gardner

appearance.hair_description: brown hair usually with grass or leaves stuck in it

quote: Travis Stoll, get those chocolate bunnies off my roof!
description: Daughter of Demeter and head counselor of Cabin 4. Manages camp agriculture and fights with plants in Manhattan.
lore_notes: Frequently targeted by Travis and Connor Stoll's pranks.

name: Paul Blofis
quote: I used to do a little swordplay in college Shakespeare productions!
description: Goode High School English teacher who marries Sally Jackson. Fights monsters with a sword during the Battle of Manhattan.
lore_notes: Helped Percy get accepted into Goode High School.

name: Gabe Ugliano

notable_features: reelling stench of garlic and stale cigars

special_states: Turned into a stone statue by Sally Jackson using Medusa's severed head
quote: Where's my poker money, Sally?
description: Percy's abusive first stepfather whose foul human stench repelled monsters. Turned to stone by Sally at the end of Book 1.
lore_notes: Sold as a statue titled 'The Poker Player' to fund Sally's college tuition.

name: Juniper
quote: Grover, don't you dare get yourself killed!
description: Tree nymph dryad tied to a juniper bush at Camp Half-Blood. Girlfriend of Grover Underwood.
lore_notes: Informed Percy about Luke's entrance to the Labyrinth near her tree.

name: Silenus
quote: Pan is not dead! You lie, Grover Underwood!
description: Fat elder satyr leader of the Council of Cloven Elders who refuses to believe Pan is dead.
lore_notes: Tried to exile Grover Underwood in Book 4.

name: Leneus
special_states: Reborn into a laurel bush upon his heroic death in Central Park
quote: I fought... for the wild...
description: Satyr member of the Council of Cloven Elders who dies heroically fighting in Manhattan and turns into a laurel bush.
lore_notes: His death leaves a vacancy filled by Grover Underwood.

name: Briares

appearance.hair_description: shaggy black hair on fifty heads
appearance.build: colossal, fifty heads and hundred arms
notable_features: one hundred arms and fifty faces changing emotions

quote: I remember the power of boulders!
description: The last surviving Hekatonkheir (Hundred-Handed One). Rescued from Alcatraz, he slays Kampê during the Battle of the Labyrinth.
lore_notes: Forged boulders to hurl Kampê into the abyss.

name: Tantalus
fatal_flaw: Gluttony and cruel hatred for demigods

notable_features: orange Camp Half-Blood shirt over ghost rags
food shrinks away whenever he reaches for it

special_states: Curse of Tantalus (food and drink recoil from his mouth)
quote: I am the activities director! You will respect my authority!
description: Cursed Underworld spirit summoned by Tantalus/Tychon to replace Chiron in Book 2. Banished back to Tartarus when Chiron returns.
lore_notes: Killed his son Pelops and fed him to the gods in myth.

name: King Minos
special_states: Underworld judge ghost manipulating Nico di Angelo in Book 4
quote: Daedalus must pay for his crimes!
description: Ghost of the ancient King of Crete who manipulates Nico di Angelo into searching for Daedalus. Banished when Nico claims the title Ghost King.
lore_notes: One of the three Judges of the Underworld.

name: Nancy Bobofit
special_states: Pushed into the Metropolitan Museum fountain by Percy's accidental hydrokinesis in Chapter 1
quote: Percy pushed me!
description: Redheaded kleptomaniac student at Yancy Academy who picked on Grover Underwood before Percy accidentally pulled her into a fountain.
lore_notes: First mortal antagonist in The Lightning Thief.

name: Eurytion
aliases: Head Cowherd of Triple G Ranch
quote: Geryon's a greedy boss, but a job's a job.
description: Demigod son of Ares and cowherd at Geryon's Triple G Ranch who guards Orthrus. Takes over the ranch after Percy kills Geryon.
lore_notes: Gives Percy the mechanical spider to guide them through the Labyrinth.

name: Bellerophon
fatal_flaw: Hubris (tried to fly Pegasus to Mount Olympus)
special_states: Fell from Pegasus when Zeus sent a gadfly to sting the horse
quote: With Pegasus, I can conquer the heavens!
description: Ancient demigod son of Poseidon who tamed Pegasus with Athena's golden bridle and killed the Chimera.
lore_notes: Paralyzed when he fell from Pegasus trying to enter Olympus.

name: Atalanta
aliases: Heroine of the Calydonian Boar Hunt
special_states: Tricked in a footrace by Hippomenes using golden apples of Aphrodite
quote: First blood to me!
description: Famous Greek heroine raised by bears who drew first blood on the Calydonian Boar and defeated all suitors in footraces.
lore_notes: Turned into a lion by Cybele after desecrating a temple.

name: Psyche
special_states: Completed Aphrodite's four impossible tasks to reunite with Eros and gain ambrosia immortality
quote: Love cannot live where there is no trust.
description: Mortal princess whose beauty rivaled Aphrodite. Married Eros and achieved immortality after completing four trials.
lore_notes: Made the goddess of the soul by Zeus.

name: Phaethon
special_states: Struck down by Zeus's lightning bolt to stop the sun chariot from burning the Earth
quote: Watch me drive the sun!
description: Demigod son of Helios who insisted on driving the sun chariot, lost control, scorched Africa into a desert, and was struck down by Zeus.
lore_notes: Created the Sahara Desert when he drove the chariot too close to Earth.

name: Danaë
special_states: Imprisoned in a subterranean bronze chamber by Acrisius where Zeus visited her as golden shower
quote: My son Perseus will survive.
description: Princess of Argos and mother of Perseus by Zeus. Cast adrift in a wooden chest with baby Perseus by her father Acrisius.
lore_notes: Washed ashore on Seriphos where Dictys rescued them.

name: Acrisius
special_states: Accidentally killed years later by a stray discus thrown by Perseus, fulfilling prophecy
quote: Lock her in the bronze tower!
description: King of Argos who locked Danaë in a bronze tower after an Oracle foretold his grandson would kill him.
lore_notes: Could not escape the prophecy despite trying to kill Danaë and Perseus.

name: Polydectes
special_states: Turned to stone when Perseus revealed Medusa's severed head at court
quote: Bring me the head of Medusa, boy!
description: Evil king of Seriphos who sought to force Danaë into marriage and sent Perseus on a suicide mission for Medusa's head.
lore_notes: Petrified by Medusa's head when Perseus returned.

name: Odysseus

notable_features: escaped under the belly of a ram

quote: My name is Nobody.
description: Legendary King of Ithaca and Greek hero who engineered the Trojan Horse, blinded the Cyclops Polyphemus using the alias 'Nobody', and navigated the Sea of Monsters.
lore_notes: Great-grandson of Hermes. His blinding of Polyphemus created an enduring grudge among Cyclopes toward heroes using the name 'Nobody'.

name: Phoebe
special_states: immortal_via_hunters_vow
quote: Keep your hands off my bow.
description: Senior Hunter of Artemis and master tracker who plays a key role in Camp Half-Blood games and quests.
lore_notes: Distinguished from Phoebe the Titan. Resides in Cabin 8 when visiting Camp Half-Blood.

name: Maron
quote: Pan would never abandon us!
description: Elderly satyr and member of the Council of Cloven Elders alongside Silenus and Leneus.
lore_notes: Member of the Council of Cloven Elders that presided over Grover Underwood's search for Pan.

name: Jason Grace
description: Roman demigod and named member of the Seven in the Heroes of Olympus series.
lore_notes: Minimal Heroes of Olympus stub seeded to resolve The Prophecy of the Seven subject; detailed profile and book links are outside the V1 seed scope.

name: Piper McLean
description: Greek demigod and named member of the Seven in the Heroes of Olympus series.
lore_notes: Minimal Heroes of Olympus stub seeded to resolve The Prophecy of the Seven subject; detailed profile and book links are outside the V1 seed scope.

name: Leo Valdez
description: Greek demigod and named member of the Seven in the Heroes of Olympus series.
lore_notes: Minimal Heroes of Olympus stub seeded to resolve The Prophecy of the Seven subject; detailed profile and book links are outside the V1 seed scope.

name: Frank Zhang
description: Roman demigod and named member of the Seven in the Heroes of Olympus series.
lore_notes: Minimal Heroes of Olympus stub seeded to resolve The Prophecy of the Seven subject; detailed profile and book links are outside the V1 seed scope. Mars is represented by the existing Ares God record.

name: Hazel Levesque
description: Roman demigod and named member of the Seven in the Heroes of Olympus series.
lore_notes: Minimal Heroes of Olympus stub seeded to resolve The Prophecy of the Seven subject; detailed profile and book links are outside the V1 seed scope. Pluto is represented by the existing Hades God record.

name: Blackjack
description: Percy's loyal black Pegasus, able to communicate telepathically with Poseidon's children.

name: Guido
description: A named Pegasus and member of the Camp Half-Blood Pegasus herd.

name: Porkpie
description: A named Pegasus and member of the Camp Half-Blood Pegasus herd.

name: Gleeson Hedge
description: A satyr and protector of demigods.

name: Mrs. O'Leary
description: A friendly hellhound who becomes a companion of Percy Jackson and Camp Half-Blood.

name: King Acrisius
description: Tyrannical King of Argos and grandfather of Perseus. Locked Danaë in a bronze tower and cast her into the sea.

name: King Polydectes
description: Ruler of Seriphos who sought to marry Danaë and sent Perseus on a quest to fetch Medusa's head.

name: Pasiphaë
description: Queen of Crete, daughter of Helios, wife of King Minos, and mother of Ariadne, Phaedra, and the Minotaur.

name: Ariadne
description: Princess of Crete, daughter of King Minos and Pasiphaë, half-sister of the Minotaur. Helped Theseus navigate the Labyrinth before becoming the immortal wife of Dionysus.

name: Phaedra
description: Princess of Crete, daughter of King Minos and Pasiphaë, half-sister of the Minotaur, and second wife of Theseus.

name: Aethra
description: Princess of Troezen and mortal mother of Theseus by Poseidon.

name: Alcmene
description: Mortal queen of Thebes and mother of Heracles by Zeus.

name: Ms. Beryl Grace
description: Mortal television actress and mother of Thalia Grace (by Zeus) and Jason Grace (by Jupiter).

name: Maria di Angelo
description: Mortal daughter of an Italian diplomat and mother of Nico and Bianca di Angelo by Hades.

name: Semele
description: Mortal princess of Thebes and mother of Dionysus by Zeus. Destroyed by Zeus's true divine form before being resurrected by Dionysus as the goddess Thyone.

name: Chrysaor
description: Golden warrior giant born from Medusa's neck when decapitated by Perseus. Father of Geryon.

name: Thoosa
description: Sea nymph daughter of Phorcys and Ceto, and mother of Polyphemus the Cyclops by Poseidon.

name: Europa
description: Phoenician princess carried away by Zeus in the form of a white bull. Mother of King Minos, Rhadamanthys, and Sarpedon.

name: Andromeda
description: Ethiopian princess saved from Cetus by Perseus and became his queen.

name: Deianira
description: Calydonian princess and wife of Heracles who unknowingly gave him the poisoned Tunic of Nessus.

name: Megara
description: First wife of Heracles and princess of Thebes.

name: Hippolytus
description: Son of Theseus and Hippolyta the Amazon queen.

name: Icarus
description: Son of Daedalus who flew too close to the sun on wings made of wax and feathers.

name: Orpheus
description: Legendary musician son of Apollo and Calliope who traveled to the Underworld to retrieve Eurydice.

name: Aeneas
description: Trojan hero son of Aphrodite and Anchises who founded the Roman lineage.

name: Anchises
description: Mortal Trojan prince and lover of Aphrodite, father of Aeneas.

name: Callirhoe
description: Naiad daughter of Oceanus and mother of Geryon by Chrysaor.

name: Philyra
description: Oceanid nymph and mother of Chiron the Centaur by Kronos.

name: Chariclo
description: Nymph wife of Chiron the Centaur.

name: Ms. La Rue
description: Mortal mother of Clarisse La Rue by Ares.

name: Ms. Beckendorf
description: Mortal mother of Charles Beckendorf by Hephaestus.

name: Ms. Mason
description: Mortal mother of Jake Mason by Hephaestus.

name: Ms. Beauregard
description: Mortal mother of Silena Beauregard by Aphrodite.

name: Ms. Rodriguez
description: Mortal mother of Chris Rodriguez by Hermes.

name: Ms. Stoll
description: Mortal mother of Travis and Connor Stoll by Hermes.
